incident-bot: PAGE FIRED: Service=redwood-inference-api | Alert=p99_latency > 4000ms (5m) | region=eu-west-1 | threshold=500ms

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident REDWOOD-INC-2026 created -> https://pagerduty.example/incidents/REDWOOD-INC-2026 | triggered for rotation 'eng-oncall'

michelle (oncall): ack. I'm on it, starting bridge. creating incident channel #inc-REDWOOD-INC-2026

Evan: seeing similar spikes from eu-west workers, p95 also climbing. Querying telemetry now

michelle (oncall): @Evan can you grab hotpath logs and kv-cache metrics? I'll check autoscaler and routing

Ana: adding early customer impact note: a handful of requests to /v1/generate timed out, no widespread errors but latency-heavy

Lee: rolling back last canary (model-variant qp_v2) in eu-west, started at 12:07 UTC. Will report back in 30s

Carlos: FYI: Cloud autoscaler showing scale up events but pods staying at 100% gpu_mem, possible hotkey

Evan: logs show increased KV cache miss rate and long tail on attention kernel; sample queries attached:

```
TRACE: req=abc123 model=llama-70b seq=1024 tokens=... latency=4.6s
```

michelle (oncall): good catch. Ana/Lee can we toggle kvcache prefix caching off for eu-west to test? no longer than 5m

Ana: doing config change: `kvcache.enabled=false` for eu-west. Pushing now.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step: disable kvcache -> executed by Ana at 2026-03-15T12:09:42Z

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by michelle (oncall)

Lee: rolled back canary fully. Observability shows p99 drop from 4200ms -> 980ms within 45s

Evan: confirming KV cache miss rate dropped ~70%. p95 back to 340ms, p99 trending down

michelle (oncall): great. keeping incident open for 30m to ensure stability. Next: postmortem owner? @Carlos

Carlos: I'll own postmortem. Initial customer impact: intermittent slow responses in eu-west for ~9 minutes, possible degradation to some B2B customers; will reach out ops-sd to prepare comms

Ana: re-enable kvcache after 20m and monitor. will coordinate with michelle

michelle (oncall): TL;DR: canary rollback + disabling kvcache mitigated. Action items: postmortem (Carlos), follow-up: assess canary traffic shaping and KV cache behaviors (Evan/Ana), customer outreach if ETA >30m (michelle)

michelle (oncall): bridge closed. closing incident in PD in 10m if metrics stable :thumbsup:
